cloudflare.r2.infrequent_access.class_a.note: No free allowance: "The free tier only applies to Standard storage" (https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.r2.infrequent_access.class_b.note: No free allowance: "The free tier only applies to Standard storage" (https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.r2.infrequent_access.retrieva.note: Data retrieval (processing) on every read or copy (https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.r2.infrequent_access.storage.note: No free allowance ("The free tier only applies to Standard storage"); 30-day minimum storage duration (https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.r2.standard.class_a.note: PutObject, CopyObject, ListObjects, multipart and bucket changes. The first 1 million a month are the account's free tier, on any plan, Standard storage only ("1 million requests / month", https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.r2.standard.class_b.note: GetObject and HeadObject. The first 10 million a month are the account's free tier, on any plan, Standard storage only ("10 million requests / month", https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it

cloudflare.r2.standard.storage.note: The first 10 GB-month are the account's free tier, on any plan, Standard storage only ("10 GB-month / month", https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/). Read on the pricing page; Cloudflare publishes no price API, so sync cannot recheck it
